title: Tweet: the NGA tracks nonstructured light-energy craft

tellings.quote: National Geospatial Agency is able to keep track of all those nonstructured light energy craft flying around the world

Pretty nifty, how @NGA_GEOINT is able to keep track of all those non-structured light-energy craft flying around the world (go @Cardinals!). But they were lying to you when they said "we don't know how they work".

plain: A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, the US agency that watches the planet through satellite imagery and maps, tracks craft made of "non-structured light-energy" around the world, and knows more about how they work than it admits. He first said it in a post on X to Elon Musk on June 6, 2025: "Pretty nifty, how @NGA_GEOINT is able to keep track of all those non-structured light-energy craft flying around the world... But they were lying to you when they said 'we don't know how they work'." He repeats the claim to Michels. If it were true, a US agency would be tracking these craft as routine work while hiding what it knows.
